visual_prompt:
PRODUCT: VITALABH Aguaje Complex 3 en 1 (market: Colombia, Spanish of Colombia).
THIS PRODUCT'S ANGLE (what the image must SHOW, in the template's form): Aumento de glúteos.
Benefits (for the secondary texts): Aumento de glúteos; Aumento de piernas; Sin efecto rebote (no engorda); Sin necesidad de hacer ejercicio; Resultados rápidos y duraderos con el tratamiento completo de 3 frascos; Trae los tres componentes puros: aguaje, fenogreco y maca negra.
The pain in the customer's words: Compró aguaje de una marca que dice ser "la original" y no vio resultados, o los perdió al terminar. Nadie le explicó que lo que importa son los componentes puros y hacer el tratamiento completo.
Customer: 18 a 55
CONCEPT of this image (different from the other images of the batch): the customer taking a photo with friends on the weekend. Show that person in that moment, inside the template's form.
HEADLINE STRUCTURE of this template: El deseo con adjetivos: «[Zona] más [adjetivo 1] y [adjetivo 2]» + «Tu mejor versión sin [renuncia]» (the template, for another product, says: «Glúteos y piernas más firmes y naturales»). Write THIS image's main headline and labels with exactly that structure, filled with THIS product's main desire or benefit (Aumento de glúteos), in the customer's words, so the headline names the very result the image shows. Idea from the research: «Trae los tres componentes puros: aguaje, fenogreco y maca negra» (use its words when they fit the structure).
THE RESULT MUST BE BIG AND OBVIOUS, even as a small thumbnail: if the desire is MORE volume or shape (glutes, hips, legs, bust, curves), the AFTER, the last panel or the single person shows clearly MORE volume, roundness and lift, with the body area filling 60 to 70 % of its panel, in fitted clothes (leggings, jeans, a fitted dress), seen from the side or 3/4 back; if the desire is LESS of something (belly, swelling, cellulite, fat), show it clearly reduced. The headline and the labels name that same result.
Timeframes: keep the template's panel labels (days or weeks) only if they make sense for this product; never invent a number.
Color palette: the colors of the product's packaging, with the same contrast and hierarchy as the template.
All visible text in Spanish, perfectly spelled, with accents. The product must look exactly like the attached product photo.
